title: Ask a side question in the Claude pane without adding it to history (/btw)
notes: Claude Code: /btw gives one tool-less answer kept out of history, works mid-turn. SDK: no direct API; a separate query with forkSession and no tools would do it, unverified. If not feasible, comment on the card and stop without a PR. Size M.

comments.body: Built in #118: /btw calls the session's askSideQuestion (in the pinned SDK, undeclared in its types). Checked: answered mid-turn in under a second, nothing in the transcript.
Shipped in PR #118: /btw asks a side question beside the running turn, answered from the conversation so far without tools and kept out of it. Version 2.24.0.
